capabilities: Insert computations into notes via code blocks and inline code
Copy results as dynamic code blocks or static LaTeX
Use a sidebar as a stand-alone calculator
extras: Full documentation is hosted externally; the README defers to it with "Please read the Documentation for a full description."
problem: Obsidian has no built-in calculator or symbolic math engine, so calculations must be done outside the vault.

relations.evidence: It is based on Nerdamer Nerdamer for the symbolic and numeric calculations
and on function-plot for the 2D plotting

summary: Computer algebra system that performs symbolic and numeric calculations and 2D plotting in a sidebar, code blocks, and inline code.
